purpose: Tracks primary-source land-pattern evidence before a footprint is used for physical freeze or geometry-sensitive routing.

reviewed: 40 peripheral pads use the documented 1.5 mm x 0.9 mm geometry and 1.27 mm pitch
EPAD uses the documented 3 x 3 copper pattern with thermal-pad vias
PCB-antenna area and courtyard/keepout geometry are retained
The EasyEDA C2913202 auto-generated footprint was rejected because its 3 x 3 EPAD copper lacked the recommended thermal vias
16 logical SMT contacts form 12 distinct solder lands: four 0.60 mm-wide overlapping VBUS/GND lands and eight 0.30 mm-wide signal lands, all 1.15 mm long
2 x 0.65 mm locating holes
4 plated shell slots with the drawing's 0.60 mm slot width and 1.00 mm copper width
All four shell slots share pad number SH and the contact/shell-slot relative locations match the recommended PCB layout
The EasyEDA C3020560 auto-generated footprint was rejected because it emitted 16 separate 0.30 mm lands and separate shell pad numbers

J1.limitation: This verifies the connector land pattern only. The interleaved USB D+/D- breakout still requires a separately reviewed routing recipe.

primary_source.revision: official DNL drawing referenced by KiCad footprint, reviewed 2026-08-11

reviewed: Ten numbered 1.27 mm-pitch contact pads match the 2x5 cable contact pattern
All ten contacts use F.Cu and F.Mask with no F.Paste
Three unplated alignment holes are retained
Pin numbering is bound to config/design-data.json and src/target_connectors.ato

primary_source.revision: current official XH series drawing reviewed 2026-08-11

reviewed: Eight through-hole contacts on 2.50 mm pitch
Official dimensions A=17.5 mm and B=22.4 mm
KiCad footprint uses 0.95 mm drills and marks pad 1 at the drawing's circuit-1 end
Mating housing is XHP-8; select the crimp contact for the final wire gauge
Exact U1UA ordering code uses SOD-323
Physical pin 1 is cathode and pin 2 is anode
LCSC C139614 maps to exact MPN PESD5V0U1UA,115
Exact order code is a seven-position single-row vertical through-hole header
Contact system is 0.635 mm square post on 2.54 mm pitch
KiCad footprint uses seven 1.00 mm drilled pads on exact 2.54 mm pitch
Rectangular pad 1 and source pin contract bind 3V3 to pin 1
Top-push 4.2 mm x 3.2 mm body with 2.5 mm height
Recommended land pattern uses four SMD lands with 3.1 mm inner and 5.2 mm outer horizontal spacing
Pins 1 and 2 are internally common; pins 3 and 4 are internally common; actuation connects the two groups
LCSC C470426 maps to exact MPN SKRPANE010
22 uF, 25 V, X5R in 1206/3216 metric package
Typical capacitance change approximately -20.52% at 3.3 V and -37.96% at 5 V
LCSC C12891 maps to exact package code CL31A226KAHNNNE
